lesson_intros.body: Let's learn about fiesta time. Ready to start?
Time to explore Philippine landmarks. You're doing great!
Let's meet our heroes. You've got this!

sentences.text: Today is fiesta day in our barangay.
Everyone is happy and excited.
The streets are filled with bright lights and colorful bands.
Music plays all day long.
Children dance and sing with joy.
The parade has many people in beautiful costumes.
There is plenty of food for everyone.
What a wonderful celebration!

comprehension_questions.stem: How do people feel during the fiesta?
What is the passage mainly about?

sentences.text: Mayon Volcano is in the province of Albay.
It is famous for its perfect cone shape.
Every year, many people visit this beautiful mountain.
Some tourists go to the beach to see the view.
Others climb the hills and explore the caves nearby.
There is also a beautiful garden at the foot of the mountain.
Mayon is one of the most beautiful volcanoes in the world.
Everyone agrees it is a wonderful place to visit.

comprehension_questions.stem: What is at the foot of the mountain?
How might tourists feel when they see Mayon?
What can you do at Mayon based on the passage?
What is the main idea of the passage?
comprehension_questions.correct: Mayon is a beautiful place to visit

sentences.text: Our heroes are brave people.
They protect our nation with courage.
They serve our country with honor and loyalty.
They fight for freedom and defend our flag.
Many heroes made big sacrifices.
They were strong and proud.
They showed us what it means to be a true leader.
Some gave their lives so we could be free.
Others worked hard to make our country better.
They never gave up, even when things were difficult.
We must be kind and remember them every day.
Their glory will never fade.

comprehension_questions.stem: With what do heroes serve our country?
Why did some heroes give their lives?
What kind of people are heroes based on the passage?
How should we feel about our heroes?
Why did the author write this passage?
What is the main idea of the passage?
comprehension_questions.correct: We should remember and honor our heroes
